2. New defaulted const PushSubscriptionBackend::PUSH_SUBSCRIPTION_EXTENSION_CAPABILITIES: &[(property, capability URI)] = &[]. For a gated property P whose capability is not in using: /get strips P from every object, and P in `properties` => invalidArguments; /set create sending P, or a patch whose first segment is P => SetError invalidProperties [P], checked before the other validation. {"description":"Design: docs/design/emailpush.md. Decisions: docs/design/DECISIONS.md.
Note key: E1. Crates: jmap-server. Size: M.

Spec: draft-ietf-jmap-emailpush-05 §4 ("To get or set the emailPush property, the client MUST include" the capability in using; default null), RFC 8620 §5.1 (invalid property => invalidArguments), §5.3 (echo server-changed values). Design: docs/design/emailpush.md §5.1, §6 (hook table), §9 item 0; decisions 1, 9 and 16 in docs/design/DECISIONS.md.

Decision 16: NO required check_push_subscription_change hook and no PushSubscriptionChange type. Extension validation follows the chatPush precedent: the deployment's create_push_subscription / update_push_subscription validate (EmailPush backends MUST call jmap_mail_server::emailpush::check_email_push_change, E6). This bead is non-breaking.

Work in crate-jmap-server/src/push.rs (+ parse.rs, lib.rs, tests/push_subscription_{get,set}.rs):

1. register_push_subscription_handlers closures pass cx.using to both handlers. Signature unchanged (decision 1).
2. New defaulted const PushSubscriptionBackend::PUSH_SUBSCRIPTION_EXTENSION_CAPABILITIES: &[(property, capability URI)] = &[]. For a gated property P whose capability is not in using: /get strips P from every object, and P in properties => invalidArguments; /set create sending P, or a patch whose first segment is P => SetError invalidProperties [P], checked before the other validation. With the capability, an absent P is shown as null in /get and in created. chatPush stays ungated.
3. Generic, non-breaking echo in handle_push_subscription_set (decision 16): created and updated echo every extra key whose value in what the backend stored (StoredPushSubscription from create, PushSubscription from update) differs from what the client sent (the created object, or the stored object with the patch applied); keys stored as sent are not echoed.
4. Rustdoc on create_push_subscription / update_push_subscription: validate and normalize extension properties before storing and return a SetError to reject; EmailPush backends MUST call check_email_push_change, chatPush backends validate_chat_push. No new trait method.
5. parse::nests_deeper_than becomes pub filter_nests_deeper_than(&Value, usize); MAX_FILTER_DEPTH becomes pub.

There is one PushSubscription/set registration; conditional's register_push_subscription_conditional (JMAP-y1yu.5) attaches to it and does not re-register it (decisions 16, 17). jmap-chat-server memory is unchanged (validate_chat_push stays in create/update). CHANGELOG: additive, plus a "Changed" note for the echo; public-api snapshot for jmap-server (additions only).

Acceptance: jmap-server tests with a mock gating emailPush — without the capability /get strips it, properties:["emailPush"] => invalidArguments, a create or an emailPush/A patch => invalidProperties ["emailPush"]; with it, an absent emailPush is null in /get and created; a SetError from the mock's create/update reaches notCreated/notUpdated; an extra key the mock stores with a different value is echoed in created/updated and a key stored as sent is not; a mock that stores extra as sent gets today's responses byte for byte; existing PushSubscriptionBackend implementors (chat memory, test mocks) compile unchanged. Must land before the conditional epic's PushSubscription bead (docs/design/conditional.md §11).
","notes":"2026-11-13: updated for decision 16","title":"jmap-server: PushSubscription extension seam (using gate, non-breaking echo of changed extension keys; no required hook)"}
